source.author: Edwin B. May
source.title: Extensive Oxygen Depletion in Mobile Bay, Alabama

recovered_facts.fact: May documents extensive bottom oxygen depletion before early-morning Jubilees on Aug. 7 and Aug. 8, 1971 along the Eastern Shore north and south of Great Point Clear.

recovered_facts.mechanistic_value: Separates offshore hypoxic-water availability from final nearshore contact threshold.

recovered_facts.fact: May attributes Jubilees to low-oxygen bottom water being forced against the Eastern Shore, with salinity stratification and bathymetric sinks helping low-oxygen water persist.

guardrails: Do not infer exact dates for aggregate historical Jubilee counts not individually enumerated in the source.
Do not treat days without reports as clean negatives.
Use the Aug. 16 near-miss as a candidate observed control only within the geography/time actually sampled.
